title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 10: lifeless idols of wood, silver and gold, the living God who made the earth, and a plea for gentle correction.

questions.text: What does Yahweh tell the house of Israel not to be dismayed at?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "Don't learn the way of the nations, and don't be dismayed at the signs of the sky; for the nations are dismayed at them."

questions.text: Why is the idol fastened with nails and with hammers?
questions.explanation: They deck the idol with silver and gold and fasten it with nails and hammers, so that it can't move.

answers.text: So that no one can steal it
So that it will not burn
So that it lasts for generations

questions.text: What does this chapter say about the idols' ability to do evil or good?
questions.explanation: The text says not to be afraid of them, for they can't do evil, neither is it in them to do good.

answers.text: They can't do evil, and it is not in them to do good
They do evil by night and good by day
They do evil to those who serve them
They do good only when carried

questions.text: From where is the silver beaten into plates brought?
questions.explanation: There is silver beaten into plates, which is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the engraver and the goldsmith.

questions.text: What happens at Yahweh's wrath, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Yahweh is the true God, the living God and an everlasting King; at his wrath the earth trembles, and the nations can't withstand his indignation.

questions.text: What will happen to the gods that have not made the heavens and the earth?
questions.explanation: The people are to say that the gods that have not made the heavens and the earth will perish from the earth and from under the heavens.

answers.text: They will be carried into exile with their worshipers
They will be melted down for their silver and gold
They will be buried deep in the earth by their makers
They will perish from the earth and from under the heavens

questions.text: When God utters His voice, what does He bring out of His treasuries?
questions.explanation: When he utters his voice the waters in the heavens roar; he makes lightnings for the rain and brings the wind out of his treasuries.

questions.text: What is the name of the portion of Jacob, the maker of all things?
questions.explanation: The portion of Jacob is not like the idols, for he is the maker of all things, and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance: Yahweh of Armies is his name.

questions.text: What does the speaker say has happened to his tent and his cords?
questions.explanation: He says, "My tent has been destroyed, and all my cords are broken," and his children have gone away from him and are no more.

answers.text: The tent is destroyed and the cords are broken
They were burned by the enemy
They were swept away by a flood

questions.text: How does the speaker ask Yahweh to correct him?
questions.explanation: He prays, "Yahweh, correct me, but gently; not in your anger, lest you reduce me to nothing."

answers.text: In front of all the nations
Through the words of the prophets
